primary.title: ICICI Bank Q1 results preview: Net profit seen up 3.1% YoY to ₹13,164 crore; NIMs, asset quality may remain stable
primary.summary: ICICI Bank Q1 results preview: ICICI Bank’s loan growth in the June quarter is expected to be healthy at 18.5% YoY, led by gold loans, corporate loans, personal loans and mortgages. Deposits are seen rising 15.2% YoY.

related.title: Q1 results 2026: HDFC Bank to ICICI Bank, Axis Bank among over 20 companies to declare Q1 earnings today; full list here
related.summary: On July 18, over 20 companies, primarily banks, will announce their Q1 FY27 earnings, providing crucial insights into India's banking sector. Key indicators include profit growth and asset quality, with strong focus on management commentary amid rising geopolitical tensions.

related.title: Axis Bank Q1 preview: Profit, NII to stay healthy; NIM likely to shrink due to deposit repricing, competitive funding
related.summary: As Axis Bank gears up to announce its Q1 results, analysts predict significant growth in net interest income and net profit. However, a potential decline in net interest margin due to competitive pressures and deposit repricing raises concerns.

related.title: HDFC Bank Q1 results preview: Net profit likely to rise 6% YoY on strong loan growth, NIMs to remain flat
related.summary: HDFC Bank Q1 results preview: HDFC Bank Q1 results are expected to be mixed, with NIM likely to remain largely stable sequentially, while asset quality is expected to remain steady. Analysts anticipate healthy double-digit loan growth, supported by strong business momentum.

related.title: ICICI Bank Q1 Results 2026: Net profit rises 16% to ₹14,804.50 crore
related.summary: ICICI Bank reported a net profit of ₹14,804.50 crore for Q1 2026, reflecting a 16% increase from ₹12,768.21 crore in Q1 2025. The earnings announcement was made on July 18, 2026.

related.title: Yes Bank Q1 results 2026: Net profit jumps 33.7% YoY, operating profit up 25.5%
related.summary: Yes Bank Q1 results 2026: During the April to June 2026 period, Yes Bank reported net profit of ₹1,071 crore, up 33.7% Y-o-Y & 0.2% Q-o-Q
